title: Experiment stakeholder contracts and observation sweeps (working)
body:
Context and goal:

- Quick working doc to standardize the minimal "experiment contract" we ask teams to sign off on before any cross-functional canary / A/B rollout that touches the stack (runtime routing, model variants, console UI changes).
- Primary goal: reduce ambiguity for SRE, infra, CS, legal/security, and product so early signals are actionable and ownership is clear.
- Secondary: provide a repeatable cadence for observation sweeps during the first 72 hours and the 4-week regression window.

High-level flow (one-liner):
1) Experiment proposal -> light contract (this doc template) -> ops readiness review -> rollout -> 72h observation sweeps -> 4-week monitoring && handoff/closeout.

Stakeholders (example template):
- Product owner: owns hypothesis, primary metric, user-facing comms (name, email).
- Engineering lead: implements toggle, telemetry, backstop, rollback command.
- SRE/Infra on-call: accepts incident runbook and capacity gating.
- Observability owner (Console): dashboard recipe, trace anchors, sampling rules.
- CS/Support lead: prepared with canned responses and escalation path.
- Legal/Security reviewer: quick check if data flows change.

Minimal experiment contract (to be filled by owning product team):
- Experiment name: "[short id]"
- Primary hypothesis (1 sentence): "…"
- Primary metric and direction: Metric name, desired delta, MDE (min detectable effect)
- Secondary/guardrail metrics: list (latency p95, error-rate, token-cost-per-call, toxicity-rate, data-exfil concern)
- Exposure plan: cohort size progression and gating thresholds (e.g., 1% -> 5% -> 25% -> 100%)
- Duration: planned start/end and hard stop date
- Rollout triggers and stop conditions: explicit threshold values and which stakeholder approves rollback
- Fallback plan: model variant fallback / region reroute / degrade to cached responses
- Data retention / telemetry: where traces/logs live, retention window, PIIs flagged
- Linked artifacts: confluence page, tickets, dashboards, PB/PR links

Signal prioritization (how we rank which signals to act on first):
1) Safety/Legal/Security signals (must escalate immediately).
2) Crash/availability signals (5xx spikes, pod OOMs).
3) Latency regressions causing SLO breaches (p95 > baseline threshold).
4) Primary metric moving opposite to hypothesis beyond MDE.
5) Cost signal (token cost > 2x expected) if sustained over window.
6) Secondary quality signals (coherence, hallucination flags) as annotated by evals.

Observation sweep schedule (first 72 hours):
- 0–1h after activation: sanity check (smoke traces, no 5xx, canary user flow executed). Owners: ENG lead + SRE.
- 1–6h: daily runbook tasks every hour: inspect p50/p95, error-rate, infra metrics, trace sampling of 3 user flows. Owners: Observability + ENG.
- 6–24h: three focused sweeps (morning, mid, evening): manual review of top-10 failing traces, customer-facing logs, CS queue for new incidents.
- 24–72h: once-every-6h automation alerts review; manual deep-dive if any threshold breached. Decision checkpoint at 72h: continue expansion or rollback.
- Post 72h to 4 weeks: weekly regression checks, promptset evals at 0, 1, and 4 weeks, and cost smoothing review.

Concrete ops checklist (pre-activation):
- Telemetry: dashboards exist and are linked. Verify dashboards show baseline and can differentiate cohort slices.
- Alerts: create short-lived experiment alerts (noise-filtered) and set on-call routing.
- Rollback mechanism: single-binary flag for immediate disable + owner who can flip it.
- Canary seed users: define internal test accounts and ensure they exercises edge paths.
- Capacity plan: expected qps, burst allowance, backlog and queuing behaviour documented.
- Readout channel: create ephemeral Slack channel; include all stakeholders.
- Customer comms: CS has template and triage doc ready.

Communication protocol (during rollout):
- All critical thresholds hit -> immediate @channel in experiment Slack + pgp to SRE pager if availability.
- Any decision to rollback -> product lead posts reason + metrics snapshot and assigns incident owner.
- Daily cadence for first 3 days: 09:30 sync (10 min), 14:30 async summary; end-of-day short report by ENG lead.

Quick escalation matrix (who calls the rollback):
- Safety/Security breach: Security lead + CEO (auto stop on confirmed breach).
- Availability outage: SRE lead or on-call can pause traffic immediately.
- Metric reversal > MDE: Product + Eng agree within 1 hour; if no consensus, default to safer state (pause).

Checklist for observation sweep artifacts (what to capture each sweep):
- Dashboard snapshot with filter for canary cohort and baseline cohort.
- Top 5 traces showing errors or latency outliers.
- Representative prompts/responses (scrubbed per privacy rules).
- Token-cost delta analysis for the window.
- Annotated note of any manual customer complaints opened.

Hand-off / closeout (successful run):
- After 4 weeks, prepare a short postmortem-like readout: hypothesis result, metric deltas, cost delta, regressions detected and addressed, open action items.
- Archive experiment Slack channel and attach summaries to Confluence page and ticket.
- Convert short-lived alerts into longer-term monitors only if feature stays.

Templates (copy + paste):
- Rollout stop condition line (example): "Stop if avg-token-cost-per-call for canary > baseline by 90% over a 1h rolling window AND p95-latency > baseline + 200ms"
- Quick contract acceptance checklist: 
  [ ] Product hypothesis documented
  [ ] Primary metric and MDE agreed
  [ ] Dashboards live and validated
  [ ] Rollback toggle tested
  [ ] CS comms drafted
  [ ] On-call aware and playbook uploaded

Open questions / unresolved items (for triage with PM + SRE):
- What is the minimal telemetry retention for canary traces to allow 4-week post-mortem? (security may force short retention)
- Should we default to conservative cohort gating for all LLM-model changes that change token-cost > 1.5x? (cost-sensitivity policy)
- How to automate extraction of representative prompts without exposing PII? Need a pseudonymization step in pipeline.
- Can we standardize a default MDE calculation helper inside the rollout console (product asks for a single number)?

Notes / back-of-envelope templates: 
- MDE quick check: if baseline conversion / success rate = p, cohort size N, variance approx p(1-p), quick MDE approx 1.96*sqrt(p(1-p)/N) scaled by traffic windows. (put formal calc into Confluence link).
- For latency-sensitive experiences, require p95 SLO buffer: plan for + 30% headroom on p95 before 100% exposure.

Links & references:
- Existing runbooks (see ticket JIRA-PLAT-987)
- Console slice docs: CONFLUENCE-1420
- Privacy checklist for telemetry: SECURITY-TELEMETRY-2

Immediate next steps (owner Aisha):
- Share this draft with SRE and Security for quick sanity check by Fri (2026-03-12).
- Add MDE helper link and attach a sample calculation sheet.
- Pilot this contract on next internal canary (small UI change + model variant) and capture feedback.

Notes to self: this should be lightweight — aim for a single page contract that can be filled in 10–15 minutes. Keep the heavy-duty postmortem and legal reviews separate unless the experiment touches regulated data or external partners.

Changelog:
- 2025-11-12: initial outline (Aisha)
- 2026-01-05: added observation sweep schedule (Sophie)
- 2026-03-10: clarified escalation matrix and added checklist items (Marco)

END.
